content:
name: $(VersionMajor).$(VersionMinorRevision)

variables:
  - name: system.debug
    value: false
  - name: BuildPlatform
    value: 'any cpu'
  - name: BuildConfiguration
    value: 'release'
  - name: VersionMajor
    value: 10
  - name: VersionMinorRevision
    value: $[counter(variables['VersionMajor'],1)]
  - name: plugin.Name
    value: 'Clienteling'
  - name: plugin.Version
    value: $(VersionMajor).$(VersionMinorRevision)
  - name: pathToTools
    value: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\PublishedSharedTools'

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - master
      - releases/*

schedules:
- cron: "30 7 * * Sat"
  displayName: Run every saturday at 7:30 UTC-0
  branches:
    include:
    - master
    - releases/*

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: azoTemplates
      type: git
      name: Pipelines_Templates

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Check_Generated_Code
        displayName: 'Check generate code'
        pool:
          name: Azure Pipelines
          vmImage: 'windows-latest'
          demands:
            - msbuild
            - visualstudio
            - vstest
            - DotNetFramework

        steps:
          - template: Y2Tools\restore-y2Tools.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToToolsPackageConfigFile: $(pathToTools)

          - template: Y2Tools\generate-serviceContracts.v2.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              batchFileName: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Cegid.Retail.$(plugin.Name).ServiceContracts\_ServiceContractModel\Batch\CSharp_ServiceContractBatch.xml'
              pathToTools: $(pathToTools)

          - template: Git\check-diffs.v1.yml@azoTemplates

          - template: Y2Tools\generate-testMethods.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToTools: $(pathToTools)
              testCampaignType: 'WebServices'
              testCampaignFile: 'Data\WebServices\WebServices.xml'
              pluginName: $(plugin.Name)

          - template: Git\check-diffs.v1.yml@azoTemplates

          - template: Y2Tools\generate-cbpMessage.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToTools: $(pathToTools)

          - template: Git\check-diffs.v1.yml@azoTemplates

      - job: Build
        dependsOn: Check_Generated_Code
        strategy:
          matrix:
            V26:
              coreRelease: '26.0'
              pathToExternalsToRestoreFile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\ExternalsToRestore_V26.xml'
              kitsDirectory: 'V26'
        variables:
          - group: CodeSigningVariables
          - name: Product.Version
            value: $(coreRelease).$(plugin.Version)

        pool:
          name: Azure Pipelines
          vmImage: 'windows-latest'
          demands:
            - msbuild
            - visualstudio
            - vstest
            - DotNetFramework

        steps:
          - template: Nuget\restore-externals.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToConfigFile: $(pathToExternalsToRestoreFile)

          - template: Nuget\get-cbpVersion.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToConfigFile: $(pathToExternalsToRestoreFile)

          - template: Nuget\get-y2CoreVersion.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToConfigFile: $(pathToExternalsToRestoreFile)

          - template: Build\dotNet-build.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToSolution: '**\*.sln'
              packagesDirectory: 'Sln\packages'
              sonarProjectKey: com.cegid.retail.$(plugin.Name)
              sonarProjectName: Cegid.Retail.$(plugin.Name)
              versionInfoFile: 'VersionInfo.*'
              filesToTest: |
                **\Cegid.Retail.$(plugin.Name)*.Tests.dll
                !**\*TestAdapter.dll
                !**\obj\**

          - template: Nuget\nuget-build-publish.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              customProperties: 'tag=CBP=$(CBPVersion) Core=$(Y2CoreVersion)'
              nuspecsFolder: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Sln'

          - template: Y2Tools\restore-y2Tools.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              pathToToolsPackageConfigFile: $(pathToTools)

          - template: Y2Tools\generate-serviceContracts.v2.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              batchFileName: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)\Cegid.Retail.$(plugin.Name).ServiceContracts\_ServiceContractModel\Batch\CSharp_ServiceContractBatch.xml'
              pathToTools: $(pathToTools)
              specificOperation: 'GenDoc'

          - template: Msi\msi-build-publish.v2.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              solutionKitsDirectory: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Kits'
              msiXmlFolder: $(kitsDirectory)
              productName: $(plugin.Name)
              cbpVersion: $(CBPVersion)
              kits: ['E_IIS_SERVER_RETAIL_CLIENTELING', 'TASKSCHEDULER_RETAIL_CLIENTELING']

          - template: Doc\doc-publishOnPipeline.v1.yml@azoTemplates

      - template: TranslationProcess\ProcessTranslations.v1.yml@azoTemplates
        parameters:
          dependency: 'Build'
          pullRequestReviewers: 'Shopping_Dev'

      - template: Snyk/snyk-scan-job.v1.yml@azoTemplates
        parameters:
          dotnet:
            restore: true
            solutionPath: "**/*.sln"

      - template: Doc\doc-publishOnSharepoint.v1.yml@azoTemplates
        parameters:
          dependency: 'Build'
          sharePointDocFolder: '10-Contrats_WS'
          documentationName: $(plugin.name)

      - job: Publish
        displayName: Publish to ArtifactoryCloud staging
        condition: and(succeeded(), or( eq(variables['Build.SourceBranchName'], 'master' ) , startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'],'refs/heads/releases/' ) ))
        dependsOn: Build

        steps:
          - checkout: none

          - template: JFrog\upload-staging.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              jfrogFolder: $(plugin.Name)Plugin
              jfrogSubFolder: $(VersionMajor).$(VersionMinorRevision)
              softwareArchivePrefix: Y2.Plugin.$(plugin.Name)

      - job: TestAutos
        displayName: TestAutos (on Premise)
        dependsOn: Publish
        pool:
          name: Private VS2019

        steps:
          - checkout: none

          - template: IntegrationTests\launch-testsAutos.v2.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              hostname: 'Y2-TSTAUTOXXPG2'
              workflow: '$(Build.Repository.Name)_$(Build.SourceBranchName)'
              buildNumber: $(plugin.Version)
              arguments: -D:Y2_Plugin.VersionUsed=$(plugin.Version),execute.plugin

  - stage: Promote
    condition: and(succeeded(), or( eq(variables['Build.SourceBranchName'], 'master' ) , startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'],'refs/heads/releases/' ) ))
    variables:
      - group: RetailJfrogVariables

    jobs:
      - template: JFrog\promote-artifacts.v1.yml@azoTemplates
        parameters:
          jfrogFolder: $(plugin.Name)Plugin
          jfrogSubFolder: $(VersionMajor).$(VersionMinorRevision)
          approvalsEnvironment: Promote_Jfrog_Shopping

      - job: Tag_Sources
        dependsOn: JFrog_Promotion
        steps:
          - checkout: self
            clean: true
            # enable persistCredentials to keep AccessToken to the GIT repository until job end
            persistCredentials: true

          - template: Git\tag-sources.v1.yml@azoTemplates
            parameters:
              gitTag: V$(VersionMajor).$(VersionMinorRevision)

      - template: ReleaseNotes/release-notes-api.yml@azoTemplates
        parameters:
          ArtifactName: Y2.Plugin.$(plugin.Name)
          ArtifactVersion: $(plugin.Version)
